I give up. I did not change `/work/fatex_024.lean`, so it still contains the original `sorry`.

The statement is true, so there is no shortcut. A proof needs three pieces that I could not finish reliably here:

1. **Linear independence over ℚ of the square-root monomials** `∏_{i∈S} √(p i)`. Mathlib has `irrational_sqrt_natCast_iff` and `Nat.Prime.irrational_sqrt`, which handle a single root. It has no general independence result for several roots, and the only sources available are compiled `.olean`/`.ilean` files. I could not find an elementary induction that I was confident would formalize cleanly.
2. **A field structure and Galois setup for the subalgebra.** `Algebra.adjoin ℚ (range √p)` is not a `Field` instance by default. I would need to pass to `IntermediateField.adjoin`, show it equals the subalgebra for algebraic generators, show it is the splitting field of `∏ (X² − p_i)` so it is Galois, and then use the Galois-group cardinality equals the degree.
3. **The homomorphism to `Multiplicative (I → ZMod 2)`.** Sending σ to its sign vector on the √p_i is well-defined and injective, but the surjectivity step depends on items 1 and 2.

Completing this would be a large formalization of several hundred lines against Mathlib APIs I could not check against source, so I stopped here.

I give up.
